name: Abilities
effect: Sot Streak - Gain additional effects
if you are heating Up.
flex - Flexs cards can be played even,
if you're Tilted.
Rummage - You can muck or discard
this card to replace it.
One Shot - Goes to the One Shot pile
instead of your discard when played.
(One shot cards that are cancelled
still go to your discard píle).
Peek - To look at, secretly.
Duelist - When 2 players remain
(heads up), gain additional effects.
Comp Chip - Any time a Power Card
says 'pay,' you can use a Comp Chip
instead of coins.
Swap - To switch.

name: Game Terms
effect: Active - A player that hasn't folded.
Seating Up - You can now play
fire Cards. You gain heating Up by
winning 2 hands in a row. You lose
heating Up by losing a main pot.
Cool Off - You're no longer heating Up.
Jilted - You can't play Power Cards.
(Except for Tilted and Flex Cards).
Recover - You're no longer Tilted.
You recover by winning a main pot.
Draw - Take a Power Card from
the top of your Power Deck and add it
to your hand.
Mulligan - Muck and replace.
Discard - A pile of used Power Cards.
Discard can also refer to the act of
placing a card in the discard pile.
One Shot Pile - A seperate discard
pile for One Shot Cards.
Bank - Contains extra chips and
cards that are removed from play.

name: Hand Rankings
effect: and Rankings
Poker hands are made of 5 cards, of
the 8 available - (5 board cards and
3 hole cards). All the possible hands
are listed below in order from
weakest to strongest:
Sigh Card - No pair or better.
Pair - 2 of the same value.
Two pair - 2 pairs of different values.
3 of a Kind - 3 of the same value.
Strnight - 5 in a row. An ace can be
used for high or low. (ex. 10-A or A-s).
flush -s of the same suit. (hearts, etc.)
full Souse - 3 of a kind t a pair.
4 of a Kind - 4 of the same value.
Straight flush - A straight where
all of the cards are the same suit.
Royal flush - The best straight flush
possíble (1o-A suíted).

name: Poker Terms
effect: Check - To pass without betting.
Bet - To increase the money in the pot.
Raise - To bet more after the first bet.
Call - To match a bet or raise.
fold - To surrender the hand.
Muck - handing in cards to the bank.
Action - A check, bet, call, raise, or fold.
Sole Cards - Your own poker cards.
Board Cards - Community poker cards.
Exposed - Revealed to the table.
flop - The first 3 board cards.
Stack - All of your chips. (coins)
All In - To bet or raise your stack.
Bust Out - To lose your stack.
Main pot - The betting pile.
Side Not - A seperate betting pile,
usually when one or more players are all in.
